data.one_liner: Pure Dart library for reading and writing WAV and raw audio files.
data.what_it_does: Provides simple tools to read WAV or raw audio files, inspect their metadata and sample data, modify the samples, and write the result back. Supports 8‑32‑bit PCM and 32/64‑bit float formats on all major platforms.
use_when: You need to parse, edit, or generate WAV files in a pure‑Dart environment
Cross‑platform projects where adding native audio libraries is undesirable
avoid_when: You require real‑time audio playback or recording
You need support for compressed or non‑PCM audio formats
Streaming large audio files without loading them entirely into memory
strengths: Zero external dependencies – works everywhere Dart runs
Supports multiple PCM bit depths and float formats
Simple, synchronous API for reading and writing files
